raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the third step (the final Planner turn), the agent incorrectly deduced the lineage. The WebSurfer results clearly established that Richard Burke, 4th Earl, was the son of Ulick Burke, 3rd Earl. The Planner then erroneously concluded that the father of the 3rd Earl (Ulick) must be the 1st Earl (Ulick na gCeann) to make the grandfather the 1st Earl. This logic is flawed because the 3rd Earl's father is the 2nd Earl, not the 1st. The correct lineage is: 1st Earl (Ulick na gCeann) -> 2nd Earl (Richard) -> 3rd Earl (Ulick) -> 4th Earl (Richard). The Planner failed to identify the 2nd Earl as the father of the 3rd Earl, leading to the wrong conclusion that the paternal grandfather was the 1st Earl instead of the 2nd Earl.
